Momentum is supported by positive tokenized stock filing news but tempered by Bitcoin’s pull‑back from a near‑$87k high and thinning liquidity on Ether’s rally. Overall the landscape remains balanced as traders weigh upside potential against emerging regulatory and liquidity risks.
